improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.
When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.
As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
improve.coach: It's shown up in 58% of your matches and it's holding steady. Let's crack it.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.
Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.
Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
improve.coach: 33% of matches overall, down to 20% recently. Keep chipping away.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: The net said thank you, and so do I. Shows up in 67% of your matches. That's a calling card.

strengths.title: On-ball involvement
strengths.note: Heavily involved; the team plays through them.
strengths.coach: Always available, always an option. There in 46% of your matches. Build your game around it.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: You saw passes other folks didn't even know existed. 46% of the time. Teammates can count on it.
